item.title: Tara Baker murder trial focuses on then-boyfriend's alibi for second day
item.description: Tuesday marks day seven of testimony in the murder trial of Tara Baker, and the prosecution is expected to continue presenting its case against Edrick Faust. Faust is charged with malice murder and other counts in connection with Baker’s 2001 killing. Her body was discovered inside her burning Athens apartment one day before her 24th birthday.Testimony began on Tuesday with the Athens-Clarke County Police detective who originally responded to the crime scene. item.title: Driver pleads guilty in crash that killed Lakeside High School student
item.description: A woman accused of crashing a car when she was 18, leading to the death of a Lakeside High School student and leaving two other students injured, pleaded guilty to charges in connection with the wreck on Tuesday. Hannah Hackemeyer, now 20, pleaded guilty to homicide by vehicle in the first degree, serious injury by vehicle, reckless driving, and possession of an open container of alcoholic beverage in the passenger area during a DeKalb County hearing.
